title: Secure Cloud Operator: Identity and Access Management
objectives: Understand the concept of IAM roles and policies
Learn how to describe IAM roles and policies using AWS CLI

mission_brief.situation: As a Cloud Operator, you need to ensure that your cloud resources are properly secured.
mission_brief.mission: You will use the AWS CLI to describe IAM roles and policies in your account.
mission_brief.execution: You will execute the necessary commands to verify the IAM configuration.

content.walkthrough: Describing IAM Roles and Policies using AWS CLI
checkpoints: Verify that IAM roles and policies are correctly configured
Understand the differences between IAM roles and policies
common_mistakes: Not using the correct AWS CLI command to describe IAM roles and policies
Misinterpreting the output of the AWS CLI command

bug_injection.bug: Missing IAM role for a critical resource
bug_injection.symptom: Resource is not accessible due to lack of permissions
bug_injection.fix: Create an IAM role with the necessary permissions

pass_conditions: IAM roles and policies are correctly configured
Resources are accessible with proper permissions
fail_conditions: IAM roles and policies are not correctly configured
Resources are inaccessible due to lack of permissions

interrogation_questions: What is the difference between an IAM role and a policy?
How do you describe IAM roles and policies using AWS CLI?

resume_bullets: Described IAM roles and policies using AWS CLI
Verified IAM configuration for cloud resources
